frozen_classical.alns: cluster destroy-repair with exact neighborhood enumeration
frozen_classical.exact_reference: exact retained-core enumeration for every instance; full-instance exact or MILP reference for n_tasks=12 when computationally feasible

frozen_quantum.warm_start: nearest retained state to ALNS reference

paired_inference.method: paired bootstrap confidence intervals with 10000 resamples
paired_inference.multiplicity: report all prespecified outcomes; no selective omission

automatic_failure_conditions: any outcome-guided parameter tuning after locked execution begins
any overlap between held-out and development seeds
any final hard-constraint violation in an accepted schedule
any claim stronger than exact synthetic evaluation plus statevector simulation
execution_rule: Do not run without the explicit --confirm-locked-run flag. Once executed, parameters and seeds may not be changed; any revision creates a new experiment identifier.
claim_boundary: A favorable locked result would support a statevector-level selective hybrid advantage candidate on this synthetic benchmark. It would not establish real-QPU, wall-clock, scaling, workplace-safety, or universal quantum advantage.
